chapter: Teaching the Concept: gravity and the Lydian scale
title: Hearing the scales on Alice's computer
summary: Alice plays a computer demonstration of the difference between scales, and Daughtry names the Lydian Chromatic Concept websites.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Absolutely. You had something on a computer you wanted to show us.
Alice is going to play the difference between the scales, so you could hear it.
Why don’t we listen to that now. This seems like it would be a good time to.
She said that she can do it with her computer. But I don’t know if you can hear it.

I think Katea can start it, because she set it up for her. So I’m going to give her my mic. [computer sounds] That brief excerpt that you just heard was on the computer here at Mr. Russell’s house. However, you may go to lydianchromaticconcept.com, or georgerussell.com, either of those sites and hear this for yourself, as well as read the very interesting information about George Russell and his Lydian Chromatic Concept of Tonal Organization. Visit those sites.
